an4.129:1.3: sace bhikkhave bhikkhuparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati dassanenapi sā attamanā hoti
an4.129:1.4: tattha ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati bhāsitenapi sā attamanā hoti
an4.129:1.5: atittāva bhikkhave bhikkhuparisā hoti atha ānando tuṇhī bhavati.
